setName: 2001 Fleer Greats of the Game Baseball
note: 137-card base set, Fleer, released March 2001. Notable for some of the first officially-licensed Negro League cards (Fleer held a Negro Leagues Baseball Museum licence).
scope: BASE SET ONLY. The insert sets and autograph/game-used subsets this product also prints are listed in `subsetsNotStaged` and are NOT in this file: each needs its own registered key under R38/R48 before it can be ingested, and neither source publishes their per-card rosters on the pages read.
